task.description: WF-02, step 7, DESIGN-QA first pass - compares the built public pages (index, how, examples, demo, 404) of task M1.4 (REQ-111, REQ-112) at the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-5b with the approved v3 sample and docs/design/V1-public-look.md in a real Chrome 157, from a fresh clone, three windows plus 360x640, two themes, three languages, with and without scripts.

summary: Verdict FAIL by one NEW Medium finding (N1: in Russian, between 360 and 371 px wide, the speaker title of the demo («Руководитель проекта», «Проверяющий») is wider than its column and touches «‹ Назад»; 1.0 px gap at 361 px). Two NEW Low findings (N2, N3). No High, no Critical. Sample kind: sample and description.

What was compared: index, how, examples, demo (the five questions with «Вы» standing, 12 kinds of result incl. no-match and all «Не знаю», 4 of them also dark/en/kk) and 404, at 1470x784, 390x844, 320x568 and 360x640, light and dark, ru, en and kk (local set), with scripts (120 page states with a full-page twin each, 96 more demo question states, 296 demo result shots) and without scripts (5 pages x 3 windows x 2 themes, 60 shots), and the sample rendered in the same Chrome as the reference (30 shots). A machine audit ran on 364 states with scripts (text beyond the viewport or clipped by its box, contrast under 4.5:1 or 3:1 for large text, targets under 44 px, horizontal scroll) and a word-break audit on 4 pages and the demo at 24 widths from 320 to 1470 in three languages: no horizontal scroll, no target under 44 px, no text under the contrast limit, no word broken inside a word (only hyphenated compounds wrap at the hyphen), no console message and no failed request.

The page matches the approved mockup and the look closely. Measured and equal to the look: header 52, test-mode strip 33.5/46.4/46.4, stage 352/212/168, caption 27.5/24.2/40.4, main starting at 465.1/334.6/306.8, the fold numbers of 8.4 (panel 497.1, cards 581.1 at question 2, strip 727.1-813.1, its button 741.1-797.1; phone bar 84.8 high at 483.2 on 320 and 759.2 on 390), the typography table of 6.4 (body 16/400, h1 46/900, eyebrow 13/800 .08em, big button 20/900, team title 13/400, card label 17/900, speaker 17/900), all 24 dark and light colour tokens of 6.1/6.2 (computed on the page), the text view without scripts (77.1/169.9/185.5 px), the team row (under the intro from 760 to 1206, beside it from 1207).

Scene and truth: the four desks with the stage words «Принято», «Готовим документацию», «Готовим спецификацию», «Готово к просмотру», the door sign, «Вы», the caption «Картинка показывает этапы работы, а не движения людей.» on index, how and demo (not on examples and 404, as the look says), the test-mode line and the AI disclosure on every page in ru, en and kk, `noindex` on every page. Nothing moves by itself: on index, how and demo at 1470 and 320, 4 s idle give 0 canvas draw calls, 0 requestAnimationFrame calls, 0 setInterval and 0 CSS animations; a tap on a step of how.html walks «Вы» (frames only during the walk; a second tap on the same step draws nothing); with reduced motion «Вы» is placed at once in one frame; a change of theme draws one frame. No agent event, no time, no count, no personal staff name, no sample tenant word (Складеон, Лидвейв, Айгерим, Данияр, Руслан, Мадина, Ерлан) and no price or sales word is in any visible text, aria-label or title of any page in any language (texts.json grep).

Known differences met and measured: D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6, D7, D8 (default row of four), D9 (390: the last 16.2 px of «Не знаю» under the bar at question 1; 1470: the button 13.1 px below the fold), D10, D11-D15, D16-D22, decision 0124 О19 (speaker on its own row at 320 and below 360; «‹ Назад» on the progress row), О24 (sticky bar), О26 (a) («‹ Назад» 13.6 px under the bar at 320, first position, question 1) and (b) (at 390 the bar rests at 658-743 on questions 2 and 4 with the footer showing below it). decision 0124 О30 (the heading holds the focus at load on demo.html) read: the first Tab goes to the first card.

findings.question: composition and narrow window (named values: the look 7.7/7.9 rule «a title breaks only at spaces», REQ-111 criterion 12 «no text cut or over another control»)
findings.place: demo.html, question panel head, `.ask-h .who b` (app/public/css/site.css, the own-row rule `@media (max-width: 359px)` at line 1937 of decisions/0124 О19), Russian only, windows 360 to 371 px wide
findings.what: Below 360 px the speaker takes its own row (О19); from 360 px it stands beside the question in a column that is only 122 px wide at 360 (119 at 361, 123 at 365, 129 at 371) and the Russian titles are 126 px («Руководитель проекта», its longest word «Руководитель» fits, the pair wraps) and 130 px («Проверяющий», one word that cannot wrap). Measured (element.scrollWidth against clientWidth and the text rectangle against the column): 360 px question 1: text right edge 211.7 against column 208.4, question 5: 216.4 against 208.4; 361 px question 5: 218.4 against the left edge of «‹ Назад» 219.4, a gap of 1.0 px, the title touches the frame of the button; 365 px: 218.4 against 211.4; 371 px question 5: 218.4 against 217.4. From 372 px the title fits (screenshot finding-N1-q5-372). kk and en never overflow (17 widths from 320 to 1000). This is the open I1 that decision 0124 О27 left for this step; the owner asked for the 360 window. Screenshots: <scratch>/ds-qa/finding-N1-q5-360-light-ru.png, finding-N1-q5-361-light-ru.png (touching), finding-N1-q5-372-light-ru.png (fits), demo-q5-360-light-ru.png.
findings.verdict: NEW - not in any record (О19 says «from 360 px the layout of the look stays» and did not measure 360-371 in Russian)
findings.fix: Move the own-row rule of О19 from `max-width: 359px` to `max-width: 371px` (the speaker block on its own row below 372 px; «Проверяющий» needs a column of at least 131 px), and record the new threshold in decisions/0124 (an Addition) and in the look 7.9; add a window of 360 and 371 px to the e2e row that reads the speaker (ru, question 1 and 5): title text right edge not beyond its column and at least 4 px from «‹ Назад».

findings.question: states / accessibility (the look 7.13)
findings.place: demo.html result, the answer chips (app/public/js/pages/demo.js line 950, `title: q.title` only)
findings.what: A result of five answers «Не знаю» (or two identical answers) shows several chips with the same text «Не знаю»; the question that a chip opens is only in the `title` tooltip, which a phone or a screen reader does not give as the name. The look (7.13) names the chip text «<not sure>» and does not name the question, so this is a gap in the description as much as in the code. Screenshot <scratch>/ds-qa/demo-result-allunknown-390-light-ru-full.png.
findings.fix: Give each chip `aria-label="<question>: <answer>"` (the question title and the chosen label), keeping the visible text; no visible change.

findings.question: truth of a text
findings.place: demo.html result without a match, the receipt text (app/content/sai-intake.json, result.no_match_text, ru/kk/en)
findings.what: When every question was answered «Не знаю» (no storage answer at all) the receipt says «По этим ответам Sai пока не может собрать подходящий продукт. Например, данные для всех устройств хранятся на сервере, а серверы Sai пока не делает.» The example names an answer the visitor did not give. Same text for the real storage = server case (correct there). Screenshot <scratch>/ds-qa/demo-result-allunknown-390-light-ru-full.png.
findings.fix: Make the sentence conditional in the three languages («Если данные должны храниться на всех устройствах, нужен сервер, а серверы Sai пока не делает.»), so it is true for both the server answer and the all-unknown answer.

self_check: Working copy: a fresh `git clone` of the project into <scratch>/clone at the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-5b (HEAD 1ed56e7), `app/node_modules` copied in; the server `cd app && PORT=0 node server/node-main.js` printed `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` and ran from the clone; nothing was run from the working tree, and nothing in the project was written except this handoff.

Browser: the installed Google Chrome 157.0.8103.80, headless, `playwright-core` of app/node_modules, a new context (temporary profile) per window/theme/language/script setting, deviceScaleFactor 1; theme by `colorScheme` emulation plus the real theme button; reduced motion by `reducedMotion` emulation; scripts off by `javaScriptEnabled: false`. Windows 1470x784, 390x844, 320x568, 360x640; the width audits at 320, 330, 340, 350, 359, 360, 361, 365, 371, 372, 380, 390, 400, 420, 470, 600, 700, 759, 760, 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1206, 1207, 1300.

Own scripts (in <scratch>/tools): static.mjs (page states), demo.mjs and steps.mjs (taps through the five questions and 12 kinds of result: answer paths found by trying all 192 combinations against the demo route), nojs.mjs, geom.mjs (rectangles), typo.mjs (computed type), truth.mjs (texts.json, tokens.json), motion.mjs and idle.mjs (draw calls, rAF, animations, setInterval; the wrapped `fillRect` of the stage canvas), words.mjs (a word split over two lines by a Range), spk.mjs (speaker title against its column and «‹ Назад»), ticket.mjs, team.mjs, theme.mjs, howstep.mjs, samplewalk.mjs (the sample’s own walk for the camera), sanity.mjs (the audit finds a planted 1.77:1 text and a 20x20 button). The sample was rendered from its own folder with `?tenant=stock&still=1&lang=ru&theme=…` in the same Chrome.
Screenshots and audit files: <scratch>/ds-qa/ (746 png files and the JSON audits); the index with the names and the suggested selection for the owner is <scratch>/ds-qa/INDEX.md.

Not checked, with the reason: the kk texts for correctness of language (a native reader’s job, WF-02 step 8); the production build (G8/G9: no kk, no examples, no order blocks) - only the local set was run, by the task; hover states (no pointer states were driven except where a tap left the pointer on a card); a real phone (emulated windows only).

issues.text: The look 7.9 and 7.13 do not name two things the build had to decide: the width at which the Russian speaker title leaves the beside-the-question layout (N1) and how an answer chip names its question (N2). Both belong in the next edit of the look together with the О19 threshold.

To ORCH: the verdict is FAIL by the task’s own threshold (no Medium NEW may remain); by the WF-04 threshold (Critical and High only) it would be PASS with N1 recorded for the owner. The work for CODE-FIXER is the one CSS line of N1 plus its e2e window, N2 and N3 as written.

Clock: created_at and started_at of this handoff are one reading of the clock at creation, after most of the work; the handoff is the only file of the project written by this step. During the work `git status` of the project showed other files modified (app/test and PROGRESS.md by the other session); none by this step.
